subject: Can we push our call to Thursday?
text: I hope your week isn’t too rough so far. I wanted to ask if you might be able to shift our call from tomorrow evening to Thursday around the same time. Something came up at the volunteer center, and I’m trying to cover a short training session for new helpers, which ended up landing on the same slot I had saved for us. It’s a small favor, I know, but it would mean a lot if we could swap rather than cancel. I’m still happy to talk whenever it’s easy for you, and I don’t want to make this a hassle. If Thursday doesn’t work, maybe Friday morning before things get loud at the office would be okay, or even late Saturday if you’re free for a longer catch-up. I’ve got a few updates I’m looking forward to sharing, including the funny story about the donation bin mix-up, but I’m also just curious how you’ve been feeling lately. No pressure at all—just let me know what feels simplest, and I’ll adjust. The new volunteers have already made a few cheerful mistakes, so it should be good material. Anyway, I value our conversations and would rather find a time than drop them. Let me know if a quieter walk next week sounds better instead of a screen call. Sorry again for moving things around, and thanks for always being understanding about my silly scheduling gymnastics.
